// A spatial scalar field with an analytic or numeric first derivative. The
// gradient of a signed distance field is the outward surface normal direction
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Signed_distance_function).
interface IDifferentiableScalarField3D
    inherits IScalarField3D
{
    GradientAt(x: Self, point: Point3D): Vector3D;
}
